comment: M05 alpha gate: real cities on classic RWG, seed 4242 (no oceans, so no monument). Each shot's position and view come from /lostcities find (decision log D115).
title: Alpha review: real cities on classic RWG, seed 4242

shots.name: above
shots.caption: City from above: the city nearest the spawn, from south of its center, looking north.

shots.name: street
shots.caption: Street level: the primary street nearest the spawn with open street ahead, from head height.

shots.name: interior
shots.caption: Building interior: the ground floor of the building nearest the spawn, looking toward its street door.

shots.name: edge
shots.caption: City edge: where the city meets classic RWG terrain, from just above the land outside it, looking into the city.

shots.name: village
shots.caption: Village sewn into the city: a village's gate where the city's lane meets it, seen from beside the lane, the city on one side and the village on the other. The clearest of every gate within 200 chunks of the spawn (flattest ground, city and village at one height); the nearest village sits on a mountainside.

shots.name: reserved
shots.caption: Reserved lot: the core of the same village as the village shot, the natural ground the city leaves to it, seen from inside the city across the edge ring.

shots.name: softedge
shots.caption: Soft edge: the strip where a city chunk slopes to a village's natural ground instead of a wall, seen along the strip so its ramp shows in profile. The clearest within 200 chunks of the spawn.
